Enquiries and reservations
Every enquiry or reservation form sends straight to your email. This tracker is just for your own notes on what's come in and where it stands. It's saved only on this device and browser, not shared with the live site or anyone else, so it won't show up if you check the site from your phone or another computer.
Settings
The passcode is a light lock to keep casual visitors out of this screen. It's stored in the page itself, so treat it as a doorbell, not a vault. The real protection is that only your own signed-in Claude account can actually publish changes to this site. Someone without your account can open this screen and even guess the passcode, but their save attempt will still be turned away. There's no visible link to this screen anywhere on the site, so it won't get crawled or found by browsing around. To get back in, click anywhere on the page first, then press Ctrl+Alt+A (Cmd+Option+A on a Mac).
